protocol.scope: Count patcher only, no full model, loading/reset/priming excluded
protocol.inputs: Exact total-reference IDs; initial prefix ends 32 IDs before final length
protocol.lookup: Background LRU/LMDB read/row decoding plus online dictionary lookup; not disk I/O alone
protocol.transfer: Input GPU Tensor.tolist and output torch.tensor creation plus CUDA completion
protocol.compute_and_other: Residual: probability/entropy/boundary/state work, Python, validation, allocations and timer/wrapper overhead
protocol.percent: Sum of category durations / sum of instrumented elapsed durations, not sum of medians
protocol.cache: Existing 4096-row LRU retained; warmups; no OS cache flush; count state reset each repetition
protocol.limitations: Single process, patcher isolated without resident BLT weights; instrumented shares are not uninstrumented full-model shares; no optimization or refitting
